blocks.text: A grid container contains one or more grid items arranged in columns and rows.
All direct child elements of a grid container automatically become grid items.

An element becomes a grid container when its display property
is set to grid or inline-grid.

The <div> element becomes a grid container when its
display property
is set to grid or inline-grid.

rows: Vertically aligns the grid items inside the container

Specifies the default alignment for items inside a flexbox or grid
    container
Specifies the display behavior (the type of rendering box) of an element
Specifies the gap between the columns
A shorthand property for the row-gap and the column-gap properties

A shorthand property for the grid-template-rows,
    grid-template-columns, grid-template-areas, grid-auto-rows,
    grid-auto-columns, and the grid-auto-flow properties
Specifies how auto-placed items are inserted in the grid

A shorthand property for the grid-template-rows, grid-template-columns
    and grid-areas properties
Specifies how to display columns and rows, using named grid items
Specifies the size of the columns, and how many columns in a grid layout
Specifies the size of the rows in a grid layout
Horizontally aligns the grid items inside the container

A shorthand property for the align-content and the
    justify-content properties
Specifies the gap between the grid rows
